subject: Access attestation: tenant snapshot & quick artifact ask
messages:
From: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@medsight.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@medsight.com
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Request: tenant access snapshot + SCIM/SAML artifacts for SOC2 intake

Hi Jordan and Laura,

We're kicking off the SOC 2 intake for Medsight and need a short attestation package for your tenant. Specifically, can you provide the following by EOD PT Tuesday (2028-05-23)?

- Tenant-level access roster snapshot (CSV): all active user principals, role assignments, and explicit service-account bindings
- A SCIM delta sample (recent 24-hour window) showing create/update/delete events
- A SAML assertion sample for an interactive login (include raw XML, with any PII redacted)
- Short attestation checklist confirming least-privilege review cadence and which owners were contacted

We understand redaction is expected — please keep admin owner emails intact. If you prefer, upload to a shared Drive folder and send the link. Also let us know whether service accounts are tracked separately; if so, include a mapping.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Zhou
IT Audit Lead, Medsight
alice.zhou@medsight.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@medsight.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: tenant access snapshot + SCIM/SAML artifacts for SOC2 intake

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a minimal pack by EOD Tuesday. A couple clarifying questions so we scope exactly what you need:

1) Time window for the SCIM delta: you noted "recent 24-hour window" — do you want us to include a rolling 24h sample from Monday 00:00 PT or the most recent 24 hours before delivery?
2) Service accounts: we track these in a separate registry. Do you want the full registry rows, or just the mapping between service-account principal -> owner/team?
3) For the SAML assertion sample, we will redact sensitive attributes (email addresses for non-admins). Confirm that keeping admin owner emails unredacted is sufficient.

Plan:
- Laura will pull the tenant snapshot and the SCIM delta extract (scim-delta-20280521.csv).
- Mina will generate a SAML assertion sample and run the redaction pass (saml-assertion-sample.txt).
- I will assemble the access_roster snapshot and a one-page attestation checklist describing owners contacted and review cadence (access-attestation-checklist.pdf).

Once those files are ready I will upload to a Drive folder and send you links + a short checklist. If any of the deliverables need to be strictly CSV-only or have a particular column set for intake, let us know today and we'll adapt.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

- access-roster-tenant-snapshot.csv (columns: user_id, principal_type, roles, role_scope, last_login, owner_team, is_service_account)

Next steps: please reply with acceptance, or list any additional columns you need for intake. If this satisfies, we'll mark the attestation as delivered in HubSpot (HS-4729).

Best regards,
